description: A bed is in front with a pillow at the back, and two small white plastic drawer pieces sit on the blanket, one larger open box and one smaller drawer-like insert. The right hand grips the knob of the smaller insert and lifts it up and right toward the larger box, while the left hand reaches in to steady the larger box; then the right hand slides the insert into the larger box’s front opening and pushes it inward until it seats, after which both hands release and hover away.
